decisive_items: Dense infiltrate of atypical CD4+ small to medium-sized lymphocytes in the upper dermis
dense infiltrate filling the papillary dermis and extending into the reticular dermis
Molecular analysis of the T-cell receptor gamma gene showed a weak clonal band in a polyclonal background
response.rationale: Persistent plaques/nodules with atypical CD4+ lymphocytic infiltrate and epidermotropism on second biopsy favor cutaneous T-cell lymphoma despite weak/non-reproducible clonality; pseudolymphoma is less specific given atypical cells and progression.

rejected.why: Initial presumed dermatitis but atypical infiltrate and firm lesions contradict simple dermatitis.
Lymphomatoid papulosis typically shows CD30+ cells and self-resolving lesions; not supported by clinical or histologic details.
Pseudolymphoma possible but atypical CD4+ infiltrate and epidermotropism are more consistent with lymphoma.
